scientific_integrity: Geometric nodal parametrization and signed-residue zeta cases are prior work; the new result is all-residue node orbit classification and integral torus isomorphism. The exact checker is corroboration, not proof or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic is odd and prime to both coprime Chebyshev degrees.
Only the maximal torus quotient, not the unipotent cusp extension, is classified.
Historical priority beyond inspected and indexed literature is not independently certified.
title: All-residue Frobenius spectra and integral Picard tori of coprime Chebyshev curves
